mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS declines (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 9.0%, it signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE > 9.0%, 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenue expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS rise, 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 225), a higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%) increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 225), 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising labor force participation and employment (PAYEMS) indicates improving economic conditions that support corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS rises (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 90, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO < 90, 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and monthly housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong economic growth and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When both GDPC1 and HOUST rise, 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In housing boom regimes (HOUST > 600), a rising retail sales index (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending that boosts corporate revenue and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In housing boom regimes (HOUST > 600), 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when RSAFS rises (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
